title: Major Version Upgrades
summary: pg_upgrade moves a cluster quickly when extension and binary compatibility are ready. The compatibility matrix, collation changes, extension versions, and rollback plan define risk. Logical replication can reduce downtime or support platform movement at the cost of dual-write style operations.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Major Version Upgrades.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
